provenance.notes: A self-hosted Matomo (or Matomo Cloud) is the site's own: its limits are the installation's (its archiving, its web server), none published by the Reporting API's documentation (read on 2026-11-10): rate limits unknown, rights unknown - the data is the site owner's. A token_auth is optional ("anonymous" reads a site whose view access is public), so no key is required; the provider sends it by POST, never in the URL.
